subject: Transportation Systems
title: Hong Kong's Profit Machine
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Hong Kong's Profit Machine.

hook.text: Most metro systems lose money. Hong Kong's MTR is one of the few that turns a consistent profit.

buildup.text: The secret is real estate. MTR develops shopping malls and apartments above its stations.

discovery.text: Building the station raises land values. MTR captures that value by developing the property itself.

twist.text: Fares cover operating costs; property profits fund expansion. Other cities struggle to copy the model.

climax.text: The MTR now exports its expertise, running metro lines in London, Melbourne, and Stockholm.

punchline.text: Hong Kong's metro pays for itself with real estate.

quiz.question: How does Hong Kong's MTR make a profit?
